title: Add docsMode/docsDir config keys and mode-aware runDocumenter behavior
description: Extend DocumenterSectionSchema with docsMode ('committed'|'local'|'external', default 'committed') and optional docsDir. Teach runDocumenter to resolve the sprint record path from config and adapt the agent prompt per mode: committed keeps today's behavior; local writes to docsDir without committing and deterministically ensures a .gitignore entry; external writes outside the repo (default ~/.bober/docs/<project.name>/sprints) with no git operations. Non-committed modes forbid related-doc edits — stale docs are reported in concerns.

successCriteria.description: DocumenterSectionSchema accepts docsMode 'committed'|'local'|'external' (default 'committed') and optional docsDir; an invalid docsMode fails zod parsing with an error naming the key. A config omitting the new keys resolves identically to before (docsMode 'committed').

A pure exported path-resolution function (e.g. resolveSprintDocPath(config, projectRoot, contractId)) returns: docs/sprints/<contractId>.md under projectRoot for committed/local with docsDir unset; the custom docsDir when set (relative resolved against projectRoot, absolute and ~-prefixed honored); and an absolute ~/.bober/docs/<project.name>/sprints/<contractId>.md default for external. Covered by unit tests for all branches.

In docsMode 'local', runDocumenter ensures .gitignore covers docsDir via a deterministic idempotent helper (unit-tested: creates entry when missing, no duplicate on second call, preserves unrelated lines, no-op when an existing pattern already covers the dir). The LLM agent is NOT instructed to edit .gitignore.

The user message built by runDocumenter differs by mode: committed contains the git add/commit instruction (current text); local and external contain NO git add/commit instruction, explicitly forbid modifying repo files other than the sprint record, and direct stale-doc observations into 'concerns'. Verified by unit tests on the exported prompt-builder (extract the prompt construction into a testable function).
parseDocumentationResult keeps working with the mode-resolved default sprintDocPath (no hardcoded docs/sprints fallback drift); existing documenter-agent tests still pass.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build and the full vitest suite pass with zero regressions.

generatorNotes: Key files: src/config/schema.ts:299-313 (DocumenterSectionSchema — add docsMode + docsDir with doc comments matching sibling style, e.g. the verifier block at :289); src/orchestrator/documenter-agent.ts:106 (sprintDocPath currently hardcoded) and :108-151 (userMessage template — extract into an exported buildDocumenterUserMessage(...) so sc-1-4 is testable without an LLM); src/orchestrator/documenter-agent.ts:62-89 (config threading pattern via config.documenter?.x ?? fallback). Put the gitignore helper in src/utils/git.ts (fs-based, no execa needed) and the path resolver either in documenter-agent.ts or a small documenter-paths.ts next to it. Use os.homedir() for ~ expansion and the external default; project name from config.project.name (fall back to path.basename(projectRoot) if absent). Do NOT change pipeline.ts call sites beyond what's needed — the advisory try/catch at pipeline.ts:611-618 must stay intact. Do not touch agents/*.md or skills/*.md in this sprint (sprint 2). Match existing test patterns in src/orchestrator/documenter-agent.test.ts.
evaluatorNotes: sc-1-1: parse fixtures through the zod schema — omitted section, empty documenter object, each valid docsMode, an invalid docsMode (expect failure naming docsMode). sc-1-2: assert exact resolved paths for: defaults per mode, relative docsDir, absolute docsDir, ~/x docsDir; external default must contain .bober/docs/<project.name>/sprints. sc-1-3: run the helper against a temp dir fixture twice; also test an existing covering pattern (e.g. 'docs/sprints/' already present) → no append. sc-1-4: call the exported prompt builder for all three modes; committed prompt must contain 'git add' and 'git commit'; local/external prompts must contain neither and must contain an explicit prohibition on editing other repo files. sc-1-5/sc-1-6: run the full suite (npm test -- --run), typecheck, lint, build; zero regressions against the pre-sprint baseline.
nonGoals: Do not change the default behavior — docsMode 'committed' must reproduce today's output and commit flow byte-for-byte for configs that omit the new keys.
Do not touch agents/*.md or skills/*.md prompt surfaces (sprint 2 handles the skill-engine flow).
Do not add commit-behavior config for other .bober/ pipeline artifacts (specs, contracts, handoffs, eval-results).
Do not let the LLM documenter edit .gitignore — the gitignore mutation is deterministic TS code only.
Do not alter the advisory failure guarantee in pipeline.ts (documenter failure never downgrades a passed sprint).
stopConditions: All three docsMode branches (committed/local/external) are unit-tested for path resolution, prompt content, and gitignore behavior.
A config omitting the new keys parses to docsMode 'committed' and produces the exact current sprintDocPath and prompt.
typecheck, lint, build, and the full vitest suite pass with zero regressions.
definitionOfDone: DocumenterSectionSchema exposes docsMode ('committed'|'local'|'external', default 'committed') and optional docsDir; runDocumenter resolves the sprint record path via an exported pure resolver, builds a mode-aware prompt via an exported builder (commit instructions only in 'committed'; repo-file edits forbidden otherwise), and in 'local' mode idempotently ensures a .gitignore entry via a deterministic helper in src/utils/git.ts — all covered by unit tests with the full suite green.
assumptions: External default directory is ~/.bober/docs/<project.name>/sprints (project name falls back to basename(projectRoot)).
Test config literals bypass zod, so runtime reads config.documenter?.docsMode ?? 'committed'.
No tilde-expansion helper exists in src/ yet — the resolver implements ~ expansion via os.homedir().
outOfScope: Skill/agent md surface sync (sprint 2), config-reference docs and CHANGELOG (sprint 2), init solo/team question (sprint 3).
